reviewItem.question: For "Service connections that use `Direct-Server-Return` and were established prior to Cilium v1.13.3 will be disrupted, and need to be re-established", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

of.needed: whether the environment has active service connections using Direct-Server-Return that were established before the upgrade

proposed.statement: Service connections using Direct-Server-Return that were established prior to Cilium v1.13.3 will be disrupted during the upgrade to v1.16.0 and must be re-established.
